transition.text: That's everyone we found, all in my log.
Now I want to see Earth.

lines.text: When I found Pioneer, I just wanted to know where it came from.
Now, looking at Earth, I keep thinking about the people who built each of them.
Someone tested those wheels. Put a camera together. Chose the drawings for a plaque.
Then they watched from far away, waiting for news.
Some went first to find out whether others could follow. Some showed places no one had ever seen. Others helped people get home.
That's how humans learned to travel farther, one discovery at a time.
I wish I could have seen them all working. But I'm glad I found what stayed behind and learned why it was there.
I've kept their stories in my log. Now you know them too.
When you look at the Moon or hear about Mars, maybe you'll remember someone we found.
And if you can, tell someone else.
Now it's your turn to help keep these stories alive.
